|quest_reward3_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Berserk''' is a [[skill]] that applies a [[buff]] which grants increased [[rage]] effect. It requires rage to cast and expends rage while active. The effect lasts until you run out of rage. ==Skill functions and interactions== Using '''Berserk''' will cause you to stop losing [[life]] with [[Rite of Ruin]] as you will start to lose [[rage]]. * '''Minimum Rage''': Sources of minimum rage, such as {{psl|Always Angry}}, will cause hitting the minimum value as "running out of rage". ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression | c1_abbr = Rage
